A '''blood spindle tree''' is a tree found only in a dungeon in [[Daemonheim]]. It requires 20 [[Woodcutting]] to be chopped down and can yield 1-6 [[Blood spindle branches]] before depletion. Each of the logs give 85 experience. High [[complexity]] is required to find this tree whilst Dungeoneering.
